entities.summary: Aaron Williams, best known as DJ A-Tron, is an American DJ, radio host, web personality, event producer, and entrepreneur. He was referred to by the LA Weekly as "The Twerk King". A-Tron has toured nationally and internationally, performing as the personal DJ for RJmrLA and 03 Greedo, and has appeared at major festivals and award events including the Grammy Awards and BET Awards. In April 2024, he headlined and sold out his “DJ A-Tron & Friends” concert at the Observatory in Santa Ana, California, in partnership with Live Nation.
